reason: Official Claroline 1.11.10 source base is verified, but the pinned image contains one unattributed application-code patch pending Team Lead review. Latest repeated host RAM samples are 2.959-2.971 GiB, below the hard 4 GiB gate, so no diagnostic/full runtime was started. Explicit port verification is implemented and unit-tested but PORT_BINDING_RUNTIME_NOT_VERIFIED. Run B is NOT_RUN. G0 remains PARTIAL and not accepted.
